name: Trawlia
description:
Two endpoints. One call searches the live web and returns a short ranked list with the source URL on every result, and at advanced depth the readable page text or the reason it could not be fetched.

Parameters this API does not support are REJECTED with a 400 naming them, never accepted and ignored, so a request never appears to succeed while leaving out what it asked for.

Costs are charged before the work and refunded on hard failure. A basic search is 1 credit, an advanced search 2, and extraction 1 credit per 5 URLs.
